title: The pinned contract bundle's prose names 'tk cloud logs/trace' as the readers of run records
description:
contracts/tracker-layout.json:78 says a record is "read back in `tk cloud logs` and `tk cloud trace`" — present tense, and now naming the wrong binary. lifecycle-invariants.json:720 and run-event-feed.json:66 quote tk commands too, but as historical examples, which is fine. The bundle is ticks' published text (never edit contracts/ here); a bundle-side wording fix would ride the next bundle bump.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding a64e9127b329c3382cf71977616810f584107004c93531d6ecb7232cbd8e50b9 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-ogv/attempt-31): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/a64e9127b329c3382cf71977616810f584107004c93531d6ecb7232cbd8e50b9.json on the run branch.
